doc.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024

title: Playing loud in the Miles band and earlier bands
summary: He compares the volume to earlier New Orleans blues and big bands.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Was it the loudest you’d ever played? The loudest group you’d ever played in? Or did you have experience before that in funk bands or that type.

Yeah, because when I was living in New Orleans I played in some blues bands on Bourbon Street that were pretty loud. You know because we also weren’t playing in clubs, they were all pretty big venues. So it was loud but never so loud because — you know I actually played in big bands that were louder because you had brass sections right behind you. So it really wasn’t that bad because we were spread out on the stage.
Yeah. Wow thanks for sharing that.
